profile.headline: Software Engineer and Lead Data Systems Analyst  @ BBI Marketing | Florida State University Alum
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer and Lead Data Systems Analyst
profile.summary:
Driven by a passion for leveraging data science and machine learning for environmental protection and sustainable solutions, I recently graduated Cum Laude from Florida State University (May 2025) with a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science. My challenging academic program provided a strong foundation in software engineering concepts and tools such as C++, Python, and C#, along with practical experience in Agile development, programming best practices, and the software development lifecycle.

My role as a Software Engineer and Lead Data Systems Analyst at BBI Marketing has enhanced my skills in PHP, Linux, and MySQL. I have gained invaluable knowledge about ETL and CI/CD data pipelines, FreeBSD file systems and how they work with Virtual Machines, and CloudFlare distributed proxy. More information to come as I continue to expand my expertise within this position... 

Additionally, my past tenure at Byte Strategy as a Data Scientist and AI Strategist has offered real-world experience in AI applications: specifically Agentic AI and LLM Workflows, demonstrating how AI can significantly optimize business operations. Beyond technical insights, this internship strengthened my business acumen, enhancing my ability to create and analyze complex documentation, identify detailed client requirements, and assess technology pricing strategies.

Let's Connect!

organizations.name: Women Leading AI
organizations.description: Women Leading AI is a fantastic organization where women from all industries can learn how to leverage AI tools to optimize their business practices and personal lives. I enjoy sharing my own experiences and discussing which tools have worked well for me in various situations with these inspiring women. The organization’s commitment to uplifting women is truly remarkable, and I’m excited to see how it will evolve and how these moments will contribute to the long-term success of its members.
